faqs.question: How do I log into NCN webmail?
faqs.answer: Enter your email username and mailbox password on the NCN Webmail sign-in screen. SurgeWeb loads your inbox after successful authentication.

faqs.question: What is my NCN webmail username?
faqs.answer: Your username is usually your full email address on ncn.net or your hosted domain. Contact Northwest Communications if you are unsure which address is active on your account.

faqs.question: How do I reset my NCN email password?
faqs.answer: Call Northwest Communications Tech Support at 800.249.5251 or 712.776.2222 for a password reset. Support can verify your identity and restore mailbox access.

faqs.question: Which browser works with SurgeWeb on NCN?
faqs.answer: Use a modern browser such as current Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge. SurgeWeb’s Ajax interface is not supported on very old browsers including Internet Explorer 6.

faqs.question: Who do I call for NCN webmail support?
faqs.answer: Tech Support is available Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., at 800.249.5251 or 712.776.2222. Office staff in Havelock, Iowa can assist during business hours.
